title: Does Your Teen Need More Friends—or Better Friendship Judgment?
summary: Help your teenager look beyond friend count, notice reciprocity, pressure, boundaries, and repair, and choose one safe next move while you keep the safety line.
seo_description: Learn when one close friend may be enough, how to spot patterns of reciprocity, pressure, and repair, and when a parent should step in for safety risks.
release_move: Review one real interaction, support one proportionate next move, and return age-appropriate friendship appraisal to the teenager while retaining household and concrete safety boundaries.

core_belief_shift.from: My teenager needs more friends or a parent-chosen crowd before the social problem can improve.
core_belief_shift.to: Opportunity can help, but durable progress also means the teenager can notice relationship patterns, make a choice, and review what it revealed.

book_relevance.reason: The Social Playbook is a relevant optional bridge because the article builds the teen-facing capability to assess reciprocity, boundaries, disagreement, and repair.
